description: This file implements the HpackEntryDecoder class and related listener classes for decoding HPACK header entries in HTTP/2, including methods for starting, resuming, and dispatching header decoding states.

classes.name: NameDecoderListener
classes.description: Listener class converting string decoder calls for header name decoding.

classes.name: ValueDecoderListener
classes.description: Listener class converting string decoder calls for header value decoding.

methods.name: HpackEntryDecoder::Start
methods.description: Initializes decoding of an HPACK header entry from the buffer.

methods.name: HpackEntryDecoder::Resume
methods.description: Resumes decoding of an HPACK header entry from the buffer.

methods.name: HpackEntryDecoder::DispatchOnType
methods.description: Dispatches header entry based on its type to the listener.

methods.name: HpackEntryDecoder::OutputDebugString
methods.description: Outputs debug string representing the decoder state.

methods.name: HpackEntryDecoder::DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string with debug information about the decoder.
